2026_02_NYG_LA.headline: Giants ground game meets a Rams defense missing Myles Garrett
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph1: New York heads west after opening with a productive rushing performance, and the Giants now face a Rams defense dealing with a major front-seven loss. New York’s Week 2 tracker notes that Myles Garrett is headed to injured reserve after knee surgery, while the Rams’ own injury update confirms the procedure and the expected absence. The Giants have a clear incentive to lean on their ground game again; Los Angeles must replace Garrett’s disruption without allowing New York to control early downs.
2026_02_NYG_LA.model_rationale: New York’s rushing attack against a Los Angeles front adjusting without Myles Garrett determines whether the Giants can stay ahead of the sticks and limit obvious passing downs.
